records.key: A pooled spaCR screen
records.source: A pooled spaCR screen
records.translation: spaCR-skimun í sameinuðu safni

records.key: Start on Home and open Mask. Load the example data, check channels and segmentation, then run.
records.source: Start on Home and open Mask. Load the example data, check channels and segmentation, then run.
records.translation: Byrjaðu á «Heim (Home)» og opnaðu «Grímur (Mask)». Hladdu inn sýnigögnum, athugaðu rásir og hlutaskiptingu og ræstu síðan vinnsluna.

records.key: Open Measure with the Mask project and create measurements and object crops.
records.source: Open Measure with the Mask project and create measurements and object crops.
records.translation: Opnaðu «Mæling (Measure)» með verkefninu úr «Grímur (Mask)» og búðu til mælingar og myndútskurði af hlutum.

records.key: Open Annotate, inspect representative objects and save phenotype labels.
records.source: Open Annotate, inspect representative objects and save phenotype labels.
records.translation: Opnaðu «Merking (Annotate)», skoðaðu dæmigerða hluti og vistaðu svipgerðarmerkingar.

records.key: Open Classify, choose images or measured features, and inspect held-out predictions.
records.source: Open Classify, choose images or measured features, and inspect held-out predictions.
records.translation: Opnaðu «Flokkun (Classify)», veldu myndir eða mælda eiginleika og skoðaðu spár fyrir gögn sem voru ekki notuð við þjálfun.

records.key: Return Home and open Map Barcodes for the matching sequencing reads and references.
records.source: Return Home and open Map Barcodes for the matching sequencing reads and references.
records.translation: Farðu aftur á «Heim (Home)» og opnaðu «Varpa strikamerkjum (Map Barcodes)» fyrir samsvarandi raðgreiningarlestra og viðmiðunargögn.

records.key: Open Regression with compatible phenotype scores and per-well guide counts; inspect hits and diagnostics.
records.source: Open Regression with compatible phenotype scores and per-well guide counts; inspect hits and diagnostics.
records.translation: Opnaðu «Aðhvarf (Regression)» með samhæfum svipgerðarskorum og talningum leiðsöguraða fyrir hvern brunn; skoðaðu niðurstöður skimunar og greiningu á líkaninu.

records.key: High-content image analysis
records.source: High-content image analysis
records.translation: Fjölþátta myndgreining

records.key: Start on Home with Mask and inspect segmentation on representative fields.
records.source: Start on Home with Mask and inspect segmentation on representative fields.
records.translation: Byrjaðu á «Heim (Home)» með «Grímur (Mask)» og skoðaðu hlutaskiptingu á dæmigerðum sjónsviðum.

records.key: Open Measure on the resulting project and quantify objects.
records.source: Open Measure on the resulting project and quantify objects.
records.translation: Opnaðu «Mæling (Measure)» fyrir verkefnið sem varð til og mældu hlutina.

records.key: Open Image UMAP to explore measured phenotypes and inspect crops.
records.source: Open Image UMAP to explore measured phenotypes and inspect crops.
records.translation: Opnaðu «Image UMAP» til að kanna mældar svipgerðir og skoða myndútskurði.

records.key: Open Gate Editor to define an explicit population filter.
records.source: Open Gate Editor to define an explicit population filter.
records.translation: Opnaðu «Gate-ritill (Gate Editor)» til að skilgreina skýra síu fyrir hóp hluta.

records.key: Open Graph Builder to compare the chosen measurements and groups.
records.source: Open Graph Builder to compare the chosen measurements and groups.
records.translation: Opnaðu «Grafasmiður (Graph Builder)» til að bera saman valdar mælingar og hópa.

records.key: Train a segmentation model
records.source: Train a segmentation model
records.translation: Þjálfa líkan fyrir hlutaskiptingu

records.key: Start on Home with Make Masks and curate matching images and integer label masks.
records.source: Start on Home with Make Masks and curate matching images and integer label masks.
records.translation: Byrjaðu á «Heim (Home)» með «Búa til grímur (Make Masks)» og yfirfarðu og leiðréttu samsvarandi myndir og merkigrímur með heiltölugildum.

records.key: Inside Make Masks open Cellpose Workbench, choose Train and use the curated pairs.
records.source: Inside Make Masks open Cellpose Workbench, choose Train and use the curated pairs.
records.translation: Opnaðu «Cellpose-vinnuborð» innan «Búa til grímur (Make Masks)», veldu «Train» og notaðu yfirförnu pörin.

records.key: Return Home, open Mask and select the trained checkpoint; verify separate fields before a full run.
records.source: Return Home, open Mask and select the trained checkpoint; verify separate fields before a full run.
records.translation: Farðu aftur á «Heim (Home)», opnaðu «Grímur (Mask)» og veldu vistað ástand þjálfaða líkansins; sannreyndu það á aðskildum sjónsviðum áður en þú keyrir allt verkefnið.

records.key: A parasite imaging assay
records.source: A parasite imaging assay
records.translation: Myndgreiningarpróf á sníkjudýrum

records.key: Start on Home with Mask and configure the host, parasite and required compartment masks.
records.source: Start on Home with Mask and configure the host, parasite and required compartment masks.
records.translation: Byrjaðu á «Heim (Home)» með «Grímur (Mask)» og stilltu grímur fyrir hýsilfrumur, sníkjudýr og þau frumuhólf sem þarf.

records.key: Open Measure and collect the compartment or staining measurements needed by your assay.
records.source: Open Measure and collect the compartment or staining measurements needed by your assay.
records.translation: Opnaðu «Mæling (Measure)» og safnaðu mælingum á frumuhólfum eða litun sem prófið þarf.

records.key: For a recruitment question, open Recruitment and inspect compartment intensity ratios.
records.source: For a recruitment question, open Recruitment and inspect compartment intensity ratios.
records.translation: Til að kanna söfnun sameinda í frumuhólf skaltu opna «Söfnunargreining (Recruitment)» og skoða styrkhlutföll milli frumuhólfa.

records.key: Invasion and Replication read their required measured compartments; Plaque Assay instead takes plaque images or masks and may start directly from Home.
records.source: Invasion and Replication read their required measured compartments; Plaque Assay instead takes plaque images or masks and may start directly from Home.
records.translation: «Invasion» og «Replication» lesa þau mældu frumuhólf sem hvort próf þarf; «Skellugreining (Plaque Assay)» notar hins vegar myndir eða grímur af skellum og getur hafist beint frá «Heim (Home)».

records.key: An optical pooled screen
records.source: An optical pooled screen
records.translation: Sjónræn skimun í sameinuðu safni

records.key: Start on Home with Align & Stitch to inspect tile geometry and coordinate mapping.
records.source: Start on Home with Align & Stitch to inspect tile geometry and coordinate mapping.
records.translation: Byrjaðu á «Heim (Home)» með «Jafna og sauma (Align & Stitch)» til að skoða rúmfræði myndflísa og vörpun hnita.

records.key: Return Home, open Mask and then OPS; supply original cycle/site images and phenotype alignment.
records.source: Return Home, open Mask and then OPS; supply original cycle/site images and phenotype alignment.
records.translation: Farðu aftur á «Heim (Home)», opnaðu «Grímur (Mask)» og síðan «OPS»; tilgreindu upprunalegar myndir umferða og staðsetninga og samstillingu við svipgerðarmyndirnar.

records.key: Join and aggregate decoded object identities with compatible phenotype responses before opening Regression.
records.source: Join and aggregate decoded object identities with compatible phenotype responses before opening Regression.
records.translation: Tengdu og taktu saman afkóðuð auðkenni hluta með samhæfum svipgerðarsvörunum áður en þú opnar «Aðhvarf (Regression)».

records.key: A stitched image alone cannot replace the sequencing cycles. OPS tables require an explicit identity join/aggregation before regression; the walkthrough does not perform that conversion automatically.
records.source: A stitched image alone cannot replace the sequencing cycles. OPS tables require an explicit identity join/aggregation before regression; the walkthrough does not perform that conversion automatically.
records.translation: Samsett mynd ein og sér kemur ekki í stað raðgreiningarumferðanna. OPS-töflur krefjast skýrrar tengingar og samantektar eftir auðkennum fyrir aðhvarfsgreiningu; leiðsögnin framkvæmir ekki þessa umbreytingu sjálfkrafa.

records.key: Import existing data
records.source: Import existing data
records.translation: Flytja inn fyrirliggjandi gögn

records.key: Start on Home with Import and select the route matching images, external masks or external measurements.
records.source: Start on Home with Import and select the route matching images, external masks or external measurements.
records.translation: Byrjaðu á «Heim (Home)» með «Flytja inn (Import)» og veldu leiðina sem samsvarar myndum, ytri grímum eða ytri mælingum.

records.key: For image-only imports, open Mask to add segmentation; skip this when valid masks already exist.
records.source: For image-only imports, open Mask to add segmentation; skip this when valid masks already exist.
records.translation: Þegar aðeins myndir eru fluttar inn skaltu opna «Grímur (Mask)» til að bæta við hlutaskiptingu; slepptu þessu ef gildar grímur eru þegar til.

records.key: Use Measure when features have not already been imported or computed by External Masks.
records.source: Use Measure when features have not already been imported or computed by External Masks.
records.translation: Notaðu «Mæling (Measure)» þegar eiginleikar hafa ekki þegar verið fluttir inn eða reiknaðir með «Ytri grímur (External Masks)».

records.key: Open Image UMAP to inspect the resulting measured objects and matching crops.
records.source: Open Image UMAP to inspect the resulting measured objects and matching crops.
records.translation: Opnaðu «Image UMAP» til að skoða mældu hlutina sem urðu til og samsvarandi myndútskurði.

records.key: Discover phenotypes without labels
records.source: Discover phenotypes without labels
records.translation: Finna svipgerðir án merkinga

records.key: Start on Home with Measure using an already segmented project, or use its example data.
records.source: Start on Home with Measure using an already segmented project, or use its example data.
records.translation: Byrjaðu á «Heim (Home)» með «Mæling (Measure)» og verkefni sem hefur þegar verið hlutaskipt, eða notaðu sýnigögn einingarinnar.

records.key: Open Embeddings to encode object images; retain the object IDs and encoder/channel settings.
records.source: Open Embeddings to encode object images; retain the object IDs and encoder/channel settings.
records.translation: Opnaðu «Innfellingar (Embeddings)» til að kóða myndir af hlutum; varðveittu auðkenni hlutanna og stillingar kóðarans og rásanna.

records.key: Open Image UMAP with compatible measured or encoder feature columns and inspect candidate groups.
records.source: Open Image UMAP with compatible measured or encoder feature columns and inspect candidate groups.
records.translation: Opnaðu «Image UMAP» með samhæfum dálkum fyrir mælda eiginleika eða eiginleika frá kóðara og skoðaðu mögulega hópa.

records.key: Define a reproducible selection in Gate Editor using the matching feature or projection columns.
records.source: Define a reproducible selection in Gate Editor using the matching feature or projection columns.
records.translation: Skilgreindu endurtakanlegt val í «Gate-ritill (Gate Editor)» með samsvarandi eiginleika- eða vörpunardálkum.

records.key: Open Annotate and review candidate labels before using them as supervised training data.
records.source: Open Annotate and review candidate labels before using them as supervised training data.
records.translation: Opnaðu «Merking (Annotate)» og yfirfarðu tillögur að merkingum áður en þær eru notaðar sem gögn fyrir stýrða þjálfun.

records.key: Plan a screen
records.source: Plan a screen
records.translation: Skipuleggja skimun

records.key: Start on Home with Experiment Design; assign conditions, controls, replicates and wells.
records.source: Start on Home with Experiment Design; assign conditions, controls, replicates and wells.
records.translation: Byrjaðu á «Heim (Home)» með «Tilraunahönnun (Experiment Design)»; úthlutaðu skilyrðum, viðmiðum, endurtekningum og brunnum.

records.key: Open Power / Design and estimate sampling needs from explicit effect-size and variability assumptions.
records.source: Open Power / Design and estimate sampling needs from explicit effect-size and variability assumptions.
records.translation: Opnaðu «Tölfræðilegt afl / hönnun (Power / Design)» og áætlaðu þörf á sýnatöku út frá skýrum forsendum um áhrifastærð og breytileika.

records.key: Track live cells
records.source: Track live cells
records.translation: Rekja lifandi frumur

records.key: Start on Home with Mask and point it at an ordered time-series project.
records.source: Start on Home with Mask and point it at an ordered time-series project.
records.translation: Byrjaðu á «Heim (Home)» með «Grímur (Mask)» og veldu verkefni með myndaröð í tímaröð.

records.key: Open the Timelapse action in Mask, configure timing and inspect linked objects.
records.source: Open the Timelapse action in Mask, configure timing and inspect linked objects.
records.translation: Opnaðu aðgerðina «Tímaraðir (Timelapse)» í «Grímur (Mask)», stilltu tímaupplýsingar og skoðaðu tengda hluti.

records.key: Open Measure on the tracked project to quantify the objects.
records.source: Open Measure on the tracked project to quantify the objects.
records.translation: Opnaðu «Mæling (Measure)» fyrir verkefnið með rakningunni til að mæla hlutina.

records.key: Inside Measure open Motility Assay and check frame interval, pixel calibration and track filters.
records.source: Inside Measure open Motility Assay and check frame interval, pixel calibration and track filters.
records.translation: Opnaðu «Hreyfanleikapróf (Motility Assay)» innan «Mæling (Measure)» og athugaðu tímabil milli mynda, kvörðun myndpunkta og síur fyrir ferla.

records.key: Start on Home with {module}. Next shows the route; it does not run the analysis. Close the walkthrough whenever you are ready to work.
records.source: Start on Home with {module}. Next shows the route; it does not run the analysis. Close the walkthrough whenever you are ready to work.
records.translation: Byrjaðu á «Heim (Home)» með {module}. «Áfram (Next)» sýnir leiðina en keyrir ekki greininguna. Lokaðu leiðsögninni þegar þú ert tilbúin(n) að vinna.
